desc_short: Acrisure Stadium: horseshoe football bowl open at one end, bright yellow seats, gray and yellow steel structure, scoreboard in the open end, green grass
Allegiant Stadium: sleek black glass oval stadium with curved silver line patterns on its dark skin and a translucent light roof, large glass opening on one side
Angel Stadium: ballpark with red seats in three decks, a rocky waterfall feature in center field, tan exterior, open outfield, grass field
Arrowhead Stadium: steep closed bowl of bright red seats, rounded rectangular rim, gray concrete exterior with circular spiral ramps at the corners, end zone video boards
Bank of America Stadium: open football bowl with light blue seats in two tiers, black steel upper rim, glass and steel corner towers, gray concrete exterior, green field
Beaver Stadium: huge open college football bowl with white seats on an exposed steel frame, press box tower on one side, end zone video boards, green field
Ben Hill Griffin Stadium: steep closed college football bowl with orange and blue seats, tall press box on one side, gray concrete exterior, green field
Caesars Superdome: huge round arena with an enormous shallow white dome roof over a circular drum of gold-tan metal panels, ring of ramps at the base, no lettering
Camp Randall Stadium: college football bowl with red and white seats, red brick exterior, tall press box on one side, upper deck on the other, green field
Chase Center: round arena with a smooth white curved roof, white and silver horizontal panel bands, glass base, plaza with terraces
Chase Field: big boxy ballpark with a retractable gray-green steel roof, tan brick and green steel exterior, tall outfield windows
Citi Field: brick ballpark with a curved arched rotunda entrance, dark green seats, large right center scoreboard, steel light towers, grass field
Comerica Park: tan brick ballpark with dark green seats, open outfield with a center field fountain, large left field scoreboard, grass field
Coors Field: red brick ballpark with a clock tower entrance, green seats, evergreen trees and waterfall beyond center field, center field bleachers, grass outfield
Crypto.com Arena: oval arena with a curved sloping silver-white roof, a tall glass curtain wall facade, silver metal panels, plaza at the entrance
Dodger Stadium: ballpark with stacked terraces of multicolored seats behind home, wavy-roofed outfield pavilions, hexagonal scoreboards, on a terraced hillside
EverBank Stadium: open football bowl with teal seats, two huge wide video boards above the end zones, gray concrete exterior with ramp towers, green field
Ford Field: rectangular domed football stadium with a shallow light gray roof, an old red brick warehouse built into one long side, glass atrium
Oklahoma Memorial Stadium: college football bowl with a red brick exterior and arches, crimson seats, tall press box on one side, green field
Gillette Stadium: open football bowl with navy and red seats, a lighthouse tower and bridge at one end, glass end zone building, gray concrete exterior
Hard Rock Stadium: open football bowl under a wide flat white canopy roof ring held by four tall white corner masts, aqua seats, green field
Huntington Bank Field: open lakefront football bowl with orange and brown seats, two decks, tan concrete and glass exterior, end zone video boards
Husky Stadium: college football stadium with two large cantilevered metal roofs over the sidelines, open end toward the lake, purple seats, gray steel and glass
Jordan-Hare Stadium: college football bowl with two tall upper decks on the sidelines, navy and orange accents, tan concrete exterior, end zone video board
Levi's Stadium: asymmetric open football bowl with bright red seats, a tall glass suite tower with a green roof on one side and a low open opposite side, end video boards
Lincoln Financial Field: football stadium with midnight green seats, three-tier sidelines under steel canopy roofs, open corners, glass and steel facade
Los Angeles Memorial Coliseum: huge oval bowl with cardinal red seats, a peristyle of tall arches with the Olympic torch at one end, tan concrete
Lucas Oil Stadium: large rectangular red-brown brick stadium with a pitched two-panel retractable roof, a huge glass window wall at one end, corner towers
